description: Search the Blu-ray movie database by movie title (German or original title), director or actor. A release year ("Alien 1979") and edition/format words ("4K", "UHD", "Steelbook", "Collector's Edition") may be added: they rank matching releases first but never exclude the movie; "unmatchedTerms" lists those no result carries. Every other word must match, so search for one movie per call and leave out descriptions (for genres, decades or themes use browse_movies, list_tags and browse_by_tag). Each result has "url" (its product page) and, if available, "shopLink", "edition" and "discFormat".

query.description: Movie title, optionally with year and edition/format (e.g. "Alien 1979", "Matrix 4K Steelbook"), or a director/actor name

name: search_movies
